$schema: SISO UI Base — prior-art clone manifest. Feed to clone.sh to vendor every repo for code study.
purpose: Catalog of GitHub prior art for the SISO UI Base — an internal, domain-tuned forge->rank->vote loop for AI-generated UI. Each entry is cloneable + annotated with the exact pattern we intend to embed.

families.A-taste-gate: Encode design taste as a gate (rules/skills/critique) — impeccable's category
families.B-visual-judge: Auto-score a UI screenshot like a designer would — the ranker layer
families.D-flow-dashboard: Flow-map + inventory + no-framework local dashboard patterns
families.E-forge-mcp: AI generation + MCP surfaces + human-in-the-loop inbox

repos.name: pbakaus/impeccable
repos.what: The design language that makes an AI coding agent better at design. 7 domain ref files + 23 /impeccable commands + `npx impeccable detect` CLI.
repos.mechanism: 27 deterministic anti-pattern rules + 12-rule LLM critique catching 24 classes of AI slop (gradient text, glassmorphism, Inter overuse, pure black, cramped padding). 10+ harnesses incl Claude Code.
repos.steal: Anti-pattern detector as a PRE-VOTE gate — only screenshots passing the rules surface to humans. Kill slop at the forge, not the review.

repos.name: leonxlnx/taste-skill
repos.what: Portable SKILL.md files giving AI agents design taste across React/Vue/Svelte.
repos.mechanism: Instruction files loaded by Claude Code/Cursor/Codex. Three tunable dials VARIANCE/MOTION/DENSITY (1-10), pre-flight checklist, hard bans, redesign-audit protocol.
repos.steal: The DIAL SYSTEM — expose VARIANCE/MOTION/DENSITY as numeric knobs in the forge->vote loop so voters tune the taste budget, not just approve/reject.

repos.name: scanaislop/aislop
repos.what: Engineering quality gate catching what AI agents leave behind — narrative comments, swallowed exceptions, as-any casts, dead code.
repos.mechanism: Deterministic, no runtime LLM. Six parallel engines (Formatting/Linting/Quality/AI-Slop/Security/Architecture) via Regex+AST+Biome/oxlint/knip/ruff. Scores 0-100, auto-fixes mechanical, hands rest to an agent.
repos.steal: The 0-100 SCORED GATE with per-engine breakdown — single numeric score the vote reads; vote when < threshold, ship when >= threshold.

repos.name: stevembarclay/pencilplaybook
repos.what: Taste skill embedding perceptual design rules as lookup tables Claude consults before every decision.
repos.mechanism: Rules from perceptual psychology with explicit numeric thresholds: disabled opacity=40% (not 50%), hover needs >=8% lightness delta, dark-bg text=#E2E8F0 not #FFF (halation), display type 56px+ gets -0.03em tracking.
repos.steal: MEASURABLE THRESHOLDS — turn soft aesthetic opinions into CI-ready deterministic assertions. Run each threshold as a gate.

repos.name: Owl-Listener/designpowers
repos.what: 10 specialist design agents running a full inclusive design process (Discover->Strategise->Design->Build->Taste Check->Review->Fix->Ship).
repos.mechanism: 36 SKILL.md files, two parallel review agents post-build (WCAG/COGA evaluator + Nielsen heuristics evaluator). Auto mode halts on critical a11y failures.
repos.steal: TWO-REVIEWER PARALLELISM — one rules-based (WCAG/thresholds), one LLM judge (aesthetic heuristics), both must pass.

repos.name: frhscopex/design-skill-os
repos.what: Installable SKILL.md injecting design wisdom from 10+ design books + 161+ industry rules into Claude/Cursor/Windsurf.
repos.mechanism: SKILL.md reasoning layer + Red Team audit (adversarial WCAG AA + strip lazy AI trends). Rules segmented by vertical (SaaS/Fintech/Luxury/Healthcare).
repos.steal: VERTICAL SEGMENTATION — load the relevant vertical rule set at generation time, not a single universal taste. Ours = performer-cockpit.

repos.name: S0ulFood/design-cognition-skill
repos.what: Four-role design thinking framework: Strategist / Researcher / Executor / Critic.
repos.mechanism: Roles activate contextually, share DESIGN-COGNITION.md with six epistemic operations. Critic evaluates artifacts + cross-checks other roles; must find structural failures not style nits.
repos.steal: The CRITIC ROLE as an explicit adversarial pipeline stage after every Executor output.

repos.name: bitjaru/styleseed
repos.what: Design system for Claude Code + Cursor: 69 explicit rules, 48 shadcn components, brand skins (Toss/Stripe/Linear/Vercel/Notion), Tailwind v4.
repos.mechanism: DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md encodes judgment (shadows at 4% opacity, one accent color, refined black #2A2A2A not #000). Rules brand-agnostic; swappable theme.css skins add identity.
repos.steal: The ENGINE/SKIN SPLIT — brand-agnostic rules engine + hot-swappable skin layer. Forge outputs engine; clients vote on skins. Reusable across all 40 models.

repos.name: haasonsaas/design-critique-mcp
repos.what: MCP server analyzing design screenshots — composition, color harmony, typography, WCAG — returns 0-100 + recommendations.
repos.mechanism: Screenshot -> analyzers (sharp / chroma-js / Tesseract.js) -> structured JSON critique. Tools: critique_design, analyze_color_scheme/layout/typography/accessibility. 2-5s/image.
repos.steal: SCREENSHOT-IN, STRUCTURED-JSON-OUT as an MCP — screenshot every variant, gate on the 0-100 before surfacing to a human.

repos.name: confident-ai/deepeval
repos.what: LLM eval framework (pytest-style) with a Multimodal G-Eval metric for image inputs.
repos.mechanism: Multimodal G-Eval: define criteria in natural language; judge LLM (GPT-4o/Claude) gets screenshot + criteria + CoT steps -> 0-1 float. Fully configurable rubric.
repos.steal: Wrap our Playwright screenshot harness; define a GEval criterion 'warmth/playfulness/clarity of cam-model cockpit' and run in CI per variation batch. THE weekend-viable starting point — no training data.

repos.name: promptfoo/promptfoo
repos.what: CLI + CI eval harness comparing LLM outputs; supports vision providers + browser CDP screenshots.
repos.mechanism: llm-rubric assertion: write a natural-language rubric, judge model scores; any vision model as judge; matrix comparison across prompt variants.
repos.steal: Browser provider captures a screenshot per variant, llm-rubric per aesthetic dimension -> RANKED MATRIX across all variants in one CLI call.

repos.name: Q-Future/Q-Align
repos.what: ICML 2024 all-in-one visual quality model (IQA+IAA+VQA); fine-tunes an LMM with discrete text levels.
repos.mechanism: LMM predicts discrete level (bad/poor/fair/good/excellent); inference extracts weighted token log-probs -> continuous float. SOTA on 12 benchmarks.
repos.steal: DISCRETE-LEVEL FINE-TUNING — fine-tune on ~50 hand-rated cockpit screenshots ('performer warmth: poor/fair/good/excellent') -> a ranker calibrated to SHAAN's taste. The long-term production scorer.

repos.name: uimodeling/UIClip
repos.what: CLIP B/32 fine-tuned in 4 stages on 2.3M UI screenshots + 1,200 designer ratings (UIST 2024). Weights on HuggingFace.
repos.mechanism: Cosine similarity between UI screenshot embedding + text description embedding -> continuous design-quality score. Trained contrastively on (original, jittered-defect) pairs.
repos.steal: The JITTER TRICK — generate hundreds of inferior cockpit variants cheaply (degrade color/contrast/spacing) as negative anchors; calibrate a ranker with few human labels.

repos.name: google-research-datasets/uicrit
repos.what: Google/Berkeley dataset: 3,059 human critiques + 1-10 aesthetic/usability/overall scores for 1,000 mobile UI screenshots (UIST 2024).
repos.mechanism: Human annotators rate 1-10 on aesthetics/usability/overall; bounding boxes tie critiques to regions; fine-tuning LMMs gave +55% feedback-quality gain.
repos.steal: REGION-PINNED CRITIQUE — fine-tune so the scorer returns a number AND a region-pinned critique you can show Shaan ('this corner is the problem').

repos.name: discus0434/aesthetic-predictor-v2-5
repos.what: SigLIP-based aesthetic scorer (1-10), broader domain coverage than LAION (illustrations, stylized art).
repos.mechanism: SigLIP image encoder -> MLP head -> float score; generalizes beyond photographic aesthetics.
repos.steal: FAST PRE-FILTER calibrated for STYLIZED content (our glossy-candy look) — drop disasters in <10ms before the expensive VLM judge runs.

repos.name: idealo/image-quality-assessment
repos.what: TF implementation of Google NIMA — aesthetic (AVA) + technical (TID2013) quality models.
repos.mechanism: CNN predicts the FULL distribution of human ratings 1-10 (Earth Mover's Distance loss) -> mean + std.
repos.steal: RATING-DISTRIBUTION output (mean + variance) — high variance = polarizing design, low variance = safe. Filter out high-risk designs before the human vote.

repos.name: GoogleChrome/lighthouse
repos.what: Automated web audit (Chrome team) — 0-100 across Performance/Accessibility/Best-Practices/SEO.
repos.mechanism: Weighted aggregate of axe-core a11y violations + perf metrics + best-practice checks -> 0-100/category. Accessibility score is deterministic rule-based.
repos.steal: Run Lighthouse ACCESSIBILITY 0-100 as a HARD GATE before any aesthetic score — low contrast / broken ARIA fails the warmth test by definition. Free, fast, deterministic.

repos.name: shadcn-ui/ui
repos.what: Copy-paste component library + `shadcn add` CLI that installs components from any registry URL.
repos.mechanism: registry.json schema (registry:component/block/ui) + `shadcn build`. One JSON per component: type, files, dependencies, install target.
repos.steal: registry-item JSON CONTRACT + static /api/r/<name>.json endpoints — agents fetch, humans browse, `shadcn add <url>` just works for anything we promote.

repos.name: google-labs-code/design.md
repos.what: Format spec for a YAML-frontmatter + Markdown DESIGN.md encoding a full design system for AI agents.
repos.mechanism: YAML frontmatter = machine-readable tokens; Markdown body = human rationale. One file at repo root; every agent reads it.
repos.steal: DESIGN.md PER SLOT — attach a tiny DESIGN.md constraint to each page slot so the forge knows the slot's visual language before first render.

repos.name: moroshko/react-scanner
repos.what: CLI that walks a codebase and emits every React component + props usage as JSON.
repos.mechanism: Static AST walk -> JSON of components + prop usage counts.
repos.steal: Feed JSON into each slot's detail pane -> LIVE 'used in N places' counts from the actual cockpit code. Inventory becomes a living audit.

repos.name: antvis/X6
repos.what: Vanilla-JS SVG+HTML diagramming library — custom nodes, ports, events, JSON graph serialization.
repos.mechanism: Node + named ports + edges; click handlers per port; serializes to JSON. No React.
repos.steal: PORT MODEL = SLOT MODEL — click a port -> render slot detail. Only adopt if the Map needs drag-to-reconnect editing; otherwise hand-rolled HTML stays.

repos.name: 21st-dev/magic-mcp
repos.what: MCP server generating React components from a /ui natural-language prompt, pulling from 21st.dev's library.
repos.mechanism: /ui <description> tool call -> generated component (registry-item shape) + file diff. Community-published components.
repos.steal: The /ui <description> TOOL SHAPE — agents request a component by description, get registry-item JSON + diff. Query the curated library first, adapt the closest match.

repos.name: langchain-ai/agent-inbox
repos.what: Inbox UX for human-in-the-loop agents — renders rich interrupt descriptions, collects structured human responses.
repos.mechanism: Every agent interrupt is a typed payload; inbox renders uniformly; collects approve/reject/revise.
repos.steal: INTERRUPT-AS-INBOX-ITEM — every forge run emits a typed payload (screenshot URL + diff + meta). Validates our Needs-You design exactly.

repos.name: las-team/lastest
repos.what: Visual-regression platform (pixelmatch/SSIM/Butteraugli) + AI-proposed fixes + 50-tool MCP server.
repos.mechanism: Perceptual diff engines + MCP tools to run tests, approve baselines, heal tests autonomously.
repos.steal: MCP APPROVE/REJECT PRIMITIVES (approve_baseline / reject_variation / request_revision) — Claude+Codex vote in CI through the same interface as humans.

repos.name: abi/screenshot-to-code
repos.what: Drop a screenshot -> clean HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue. GPT-4V / Claude Opus / video.
repos.mechanism: Screenshot -> structured spec -> code generation -> re-render loop.
repos.steal: SCREENSHOT -> SPEC -> RE-RENDER loop — the 'forge screenshot -> extract intent -> regenerate' pattern for component variation forging.
